question:
The value of universal gravitation constant (G) was determined by:

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Antoine L Lavoisier
Henry Cavendish
Isaac Newton
John Dalton
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Henry Cavendish

Explanation:
The value of the universal gravitation constant (G) was first determined by Henry Cavendish in 1798 using a torsion balance experiment, famously known as the 'Cavendish Experiment'. He measured the gravitational force between two known masses. Although Isaac Newton formulated the law of universal gravitation, it was Cavendish who calculated the precise value of G. The accepted value of G is approximately 6.67430 × 10^-11 N m²/kg².

Extra Facts:
☛ G is a fundamental physical constant that determines the strength of the gravitational force between two objects.
☛ Cavendish's experiment also helped in calculating the mass of the Earth.
☛ The value of G is constant throughout the universe, hence it is called 'universal'.
☛ Newton's law of gravitation formula: F = G (m₁m₂)/r².

हेनरी केवेन्डिश
आइजैक न्यूटन
जॉन डाल्टन
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है हेनरी केवेन्डिश

Explanation:
सार्वभौमिक गुरुत्वाकर्षण स्थिरांक (G) की खोज और इसके मान की गणना सबसे पहले हेनरी केवेन्डिश ने 1798 में की थी। उन्होंने एक टॉरशन बैलेंस (ऐंठन तुला) का उपयोग करके दो ज्ञात द्रव्यमानों के बीच गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल को मापा। इस प्रयोग को 'केवेन्डिश प्रयोग' के नाम से जाना जाता है। न्यूटन ने गुरुत्वाकर्षण के नियम का प्रतिपादन किया था, लेकिन G का मान निर्धारित करने का श्रेय केवेन्डिश को जाता है। G का मान लगभग 6.67430 × 10^-11 N m²/kg² होता है।

☛ G एक मौलिक भौतिक स्थिरांक है जो दो वस्तुओं के बीच गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल की तीव्रता को निर्धारित करता है।

question:
Who among the following physicists invented the voltaic pile, the forerunner of the modern battery, in 1800?

[SSC CPO 2024]
options: Andre-Marie Ampere
George Simon
Alessandro Volta
Hans Christian Oersted
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Alessandro Volta

Explanation:
Alessandro Volta invented the voltaic pile in 1800, which was the forerunner of the modern battery. It was the first electrochemical cell capable of producing a continuous electric current. The voltaic pile consisted of alternating discs of zinc and copper separated by pieces of cardboard soaked in saltwater or acid, converting chemical energy into electrical energy. This invention revolutionized the field of electricity and laid the foundation for modern battery technology. In honor of his contribution, the unit of electric potential (voltage) was named 'volt' after him.

Extra Facts:
1. The voltaic pile is also known as the 'voltaic cell' and was the first device to convert chemical energy into electrical energy.
2. Volta's experiments led to the development of the galvanic cell concept, which was later advanced by Luigi Galvani.
3. Volta's invention was a significant milestone in the development of electrochemistry.
4. Volta also discovered methane gas, another important aspect of his scientific contributions.

question_hi:
1800 में, निम्नलिखित भौतिक विज्ञानियों में से किसने, आधुनिक बैटरी के पूर्वगामी वोल्टाइक पाइल का आविष्कार किया था ?

हैंस क्रिश्चियन ओस्टेड (Hans Christian Oersted)
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है एलेसेंड्रो वोल्टा (Alessandro Volta)

Explanation:
एलेसेंड्रो वोल्टा ने 1800 में वोल्टाइक पाइल का आविष्कार किया था, जो आधुनिक बैटरी का पूर्वगामी था। यह पहला इलेक्ट्रोकेमिकल सेल था जो निरंतर विद्युत धारा उत्पन्न कर सकता था। वोल्टाइक पाइल में जिंक और कॉपर की प्लेटों को नमकीन पानी या एसिड में डुबोकर रखा जाता था, जिससे रासायनिक ऊर्जा विद्युत ऊर्जा में परिवर्तित होती थी। इस आविष्कार ने विद्युत विज्ञान के क्षेत्र में क्रांति ला दी और आधुनिक बैटरी तकनीक की नींव रखी। वोल्टा के इस योगदान के कारण विद्युत विभव (वोल्टेज) की इकाई का नाम उनके नाम पर 'वोल्ट' रखा गया।

Extra Facts:
1. वोल्टाइक पाइल को 'वोल्टाइक सेल' भी कहा जाता है और यह रासायनिक ऊर्जा को विद्युत ऊर्जा में परिवर्तित करने वाला पहला उपकरण था।
2. वोल्टा ने अपने प्रयोगों में गैल्वेनिक सेल की अवधारणा को विकसित किया, जिसे बाद में लुइगी गैल्वानी ने और आगे बढ़ाया।
3. वोल्टा का यह आविष्कार विद्युत रसायन विज्ञान (Electrochemistry) के विकास में एक महत्वपूर्ण मील का पत्थर साबित हुआ।
4. वोल्टा ने मीथेन गैस की खोज भी की थी, जो उनके वैज्ञानिक योगदान का एक और महत्वपूर्ण पहलू है।

question:
X-rays were discovered by:

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Newton
W. Roentgen
Henry Becquerel
Marconi
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is W. Roentgen

Explanation:
X-rays were discovered by German physicist Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen on November 8, 1895. He found that when cathode rays passed through a glass tube, an unknown type of radiation was produced that could penetrate paper, wood, and even human tissues. For this discovery, he was awarded the first Nobel Prize in Physics in 1901. Today, X-rays are widely used in medical, security, and industrial applications.

Extra Facts:
X-rays are electromagnetic waves with wavelengths between 0.01 to 10 nanometers. These high-energy waves can penetrate dense materials. In the medical field, X-rays are used to detect bone fractures and other internal injuries. Additionally, they are used for security checks at airports and for detecting metal defects in industrial applications.

Roentgen) ने 8 नवंबर, 1895 को की थी। उन्होंने पाया कि जब कैथोड किरणें कांच की नली से गुजरती हैं, तो एक अज्ञात प्रकार की विकिरण उत्पन्न होती है जो कागज, लकड़ी और यहां तक कि मानव ऊतकों को भेद सकती है। इस खोज के लिए उन्हें 1901 में पहला नोबेल पुरस्कार भी मिला। एक्स-रे का उपयोग आज चिकित्सा, सुरक्षा और औद्योगिक अनुप्रयोगों में व्यापक रूप से किया जाता है।

Extra Facts:
एक्स-रे विद्युत चुम्बकीय तरंगें हैं जिनकी तरंगदैर्ध्य 0.01 से 10 नैनोमीटर के बीच होती है। ये उच्च ऊर्जा वाली तरंगें हैं जो घने पदार्थों में भी प्रवेश कर सकती हैं। चिकित्सा क्षेत्र में एक्स-रे का उपयोग हड्डियों के फ्रैक्चर और अन्य आंतरिक चोटों का पता लगाने के लिए किया जाता है। इसके अलावा, हवाई अड्डों पर सुरक्षा जांच और औद्योगिक क्षेत्र में धातु के दोषों का पता लगाने के लिए भी एक्स-रे का उपयोग किया जाता है।

question:
Automobiles are fitted with a device that shows the distance travelled. identify it.

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Odometer
Autometer
RPM meter
Speedometer
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Odometer

Explanation:
An odometer is a device that measures and displays the total distance traveled by a vehicle. It calculates the distance by counting the number of rotations of the vehicle's wheels. Odometers are primarily used in automobiles and help in tracking mileage, maintenance, and service intervals. They can be mechanical or electronic. A speedometer shows the current speed of the vehicle, while an RPM meter measures the engine's revolutions per minute. An autometer is not a standard device.

Extra Facts:
The odometer was invented by William Clayton in 1847. Modern odometers are digital and provide higher accuracy. They are located on the vehicle's dashboard and display distance in kilometers or miles. Some vehicles also have a trip odometer that measures the distance of a specific journey. Odometer readings are also used in vehicle valuation and insurance.

☛ Who invented the odometer? → William Clayton

ऑटोमीटर
RPM मीटर
स्पीडोमीटर
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है ओडोमीटर

Explanation:
ओडोमीटर एक ऐसा उपकरण है जो वाहन द्वारा तय की गई कुल दूरी को मापता और दर्शाता है। यह वाहन के पहियों के घूर्णन की संख्या को गिनकर दूरी की गणना करता है। ओडोमीटर का उपयोग मुख्य रूप से वाहनों में किया जाता है और यह माइलेज, रखरखाव और सेवा अंतराल को ट्रैक करने में मदद करता है। यह यांत्रिक या इलेक्ट्रॉनिक हो सकता है। स्पीडोमीटर वाहन की वर्तमान गति को दर्शाता है, जबकि RPM मीटर इंजन के प्रति मिनट घूर्णन (Revolutions Per Minute) को मापता है। ऑटोमीटर कोई मानक उपकरण नहीं है।

Extra Facts:
ओडोमीटर का आविष्कार 1847 में विलियम क्लेटन ने किया था। आधुनिक ओडोमीटर डिजिटल होते हैं और अधिक सटीकता प्रदान करते हैं। यह वाहन के डैशबोर्ड पर स्थित होता है और किलोमीटर या मील में दूरी प्रदर्शित करता है। कुछ वाहनों में ट्रिप ओडोमीटर भी होता है जो एक विशिष्ट यात्रा की दूरी को मापता है। ओडोमीटर रीडिंग का उपयोग वाहन के मूल्यांकन और बीमा में भी किया जाता है।

question:
Who invented the modern mercury thermometer with a standardised scale?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Galileo Galilei
Grand Duke
Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit
Anders Celsius
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit

Explanation:
Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit invented the first modern mercury thermometer with a standardized scale (Fahrenheit scale) in 1714. He used mercury, which provides more accurate temperature measurements than alcohol because it expands at a uniform rate and can measure higher temperatures. In the Fahrenheit scale, the freezing point of water is set at 32°F and the boiling point at 212°F. This thermometer is widely used in medical, meteorological, and industrial applications.

Extra Facts:
☛ Anders Celsius proposed the Celsius scale in 1742, where the freezing point of water is 0°C and the boiling point is 100°C.
☛ Galileo Galilei invented the thermoscope, which indicated temperature changes but lacked a standardized scale.
☛ Mercury thermometers are now banned in many countries due to environmental concerns as mercury is a toxic metal.

☛ Who invented the Celsius scale? → Anders Celsius

☛ In which year was the mercury thermometer developed? → 1714

मानकीकृत पैमाने के साथ आधुनिक पारा थर्मामीटर का आविष्कार किसने किया?

solution_hi:

Explanation:
डेनियल गेब्रियल फारेनहाइट ने 1714 में पहला आधुनिक पारा थर्मामीटर विकसित किया, जिसमें एक मानकीकृत पैमाना (फारेनहाइट स्केल) था। उन्होंने पारा (Mercury) का उपयोग किया, जो अल्कोहल की तुलना में अधिक सटीक तापमान माप प्रदान करता है क्योंकि यह एक समान दर से फैलता है और उच्च तापमान को माप सकता है। फारेनहाइट स्केल में, पानी का हिमांक (Freezing Point) 32°F और क्वथनांक (Boiling Point) 212°F पर सेट किया गया है। यह थर्मामीटर चिकित्सा, मौसम विज्ञान और औद्योगिक अनुप्रयोगों में व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है।

question:
Which British scientist is known for developing the principle of holography in 1947 to improve the resolution of the electron microscope?

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Dennis Gabor

Explanation:
Dennis Gabor was a British-Hungarian physicist who developed the principle of holography in 1947 to improve the resolution of the electron microscope. Holography is a technique that uses light waves to create three-dimensional (3D) images. Gabor introduced the concept of 'whole recording,' capturing both the intensity and phase of light. For this groundbreaking work, he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1971. His invention revolutionized imaging technology and found applications in various fields.

question:
Who is considered as the ‘Father of Nuclear Physics’?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Neils Bohr
J. Chadwick
E. Rutherford
J.J. Thomson
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is E. Rutherford

Explanation:
E. Rutherford is considered the 'Father of Nuclear Physics'. He made groundbreaking discoveries about atomic structure, including the discovery of the atomic nucleus. Through his famous 'Gold Foil Experiment' (1911), he demonstrated that most of an atom's mass is concentrated in a tiny nucleus, with electrons orbiting around it. This model is known as the 'Rutherford Atomic Model'. He also identified and studied the properties of alpha, beta, and gamma rays in radioactivity. Due to these contributions, he is regarded as the founder of nuclear physics.

Extra Facts:
1. Rutherford won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1908 for his work on radioactivity.

2. He discovered the 'proton' and named it.

3. His student, Niels Bohr, further developed the atomic model by incorporating energy levels for electrons.

4. He confirmed the positive charge of the atomic nucleus, laying the foundation for modern atomic theory.

question:
Who discovered the law of planetary motion?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Newton
Kepler
Einstein
Galileo
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Kepler

Explanation:
The laws of planetary motion were discovered by Johannes Kepler. In the 17th century, Kepler formulated three laws, known as Kepler's Laws of Planetary Motion. These laws describe the orbits, motion, and time-period relationships of planets. The first law (Law of Orbits) states that planets move in elliptical orbits around the Sun. The second law (Law of Areas) explains that a line connecting a planet to the Sun sweeps equal areas in equal times. The third law (Law of Periods) establishes a relationship between a planet's orbital period and its distance from the Sun. These laws laid the foundation for Newton's law of universal gravitation.

Extra Facts:
Kepler's laws revolutionized astronomy and laid the groundwork for modern astrophysics. Kepler developed these laws using observational data from Tycho Brahe. These laws apply not only to planets but also to any two-body system governed by gravitational force, such as satellites and stars. Kepler's work later helped Newton formulate the universal law of gravitation.

Explanation:

question:
Who was the first to use the term 'horsepower' that refers to the power produced by an engine ?

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options: Amedeo Avogadro
John Dalton
Albert Einstein
James Watt
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is James Watt

Explanation:
The term 'horsepower' was first used by James Watt to measure the power output of engines. In the 18th century, Watt introduced this term to compare the power of steam engines with the work done by horses. One horsepower (HP) is approximately equal to 746 watts, expressed as 1 HP = 746 W. This unit is still widely used in the automobile and machinery industries to quantify engine power. Watt's innovation helped standardize the measurement of mechanical power.

Extra Facts:
James Watt was a Scottish inventor and mechanical engineer renowned for his improvements to the steam engine. His work revolutionized industrial machinery by enhancing efficiency. The term 'horsepower' became a benchmark for comparing machine capabilities. Today, it is used not only for vehicles but also for electric motors and other mechanical devices. Watt's contributions laid the foundation for modern engineering and power measurement systems.

'हॉर्सपावर' (Horsepower) शब्द का प्रयोग सबसे पहले जेम्स वॉट ने किया था। यह शब्द इंजन या मशीन द्वारा उत्पादित शक्ति को मापने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। जेम्स वॉट ने 18वीं शताब्दी में भाप इंजन की दक्षता को मापने के लिए इस शब्द का उपयोग किया। उन्होंने घोड़ों की शक्ति की तुलना में इंजन की शक्ति को परिभाषित किया। एक हॉर्सपावर लगभग 746 वाट के बराबर होता है, जिसे 1 HP = 746 W के रूप में व्यक्त किया जाता है। यह इकाई आज भी ऑटोमोबाइल और मशीनरी उद्योग में व्यापक रूप से प्रयोग की जाती है।

question:
Which of the following was discovered by Henri Becquerel?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Infrared radiation
Ultraviolet light
X-Rays
Radioactivity
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Radioactivity

Explanation:
Henri Becquerel discovered radioactivity in 1896. He observed that uranium salts emitted rays that affected photographic plates even when the plates were shielded from light. This phenomenon is known as spontaneous radioactivity. Becquerel's discovery revolutionized nuclear physics and was later expanded upon by Marie Curie and Pierre Curie. The core principle of radioactivity is that certain elements spontaneously emit energy (as alpha, beta, or gamma rays) due to unstable atomic nuclei.

Extra Facts:
Henri Becquerel shared the 1903 Nobel Prize in Physics with Marie and Pierre Curie for his discovery. The three main types of radioactivity are alpha particles (helium nuclei), beta particles (electrons or positrons), and gamma rays (high-energy electromagnetic waves). This discovery paved the way for applications like nuclear energy, medical radiotherapy, and carbon dating.

☛ What are the three types of radioactivity? → Alpha, beta, gamma
☛ What type of element is uranium? → Radioactive element
☛ Which element did Marie Curie discover? → Radium

question:
‘(gnomon)’ is a part of the _______ .

[SSC CGL 2022]
options: Solar Clock

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Solar Clock

Explanation:
A sundial (solar clock) is an ancient timekeeping device that measures time based on the position of the sun. It consists of a gnomon, which is a rod or triangular structure. The gnomon casts a shadow on a marked dial, indicating the time. The direction and length of the shadow help calculate the time. Sundials have been an essential tool for time measurement since ancient times.

Extra Facts:
Sundials were used in ancient Egypt, Greece, and India. They rely on the sun's movement, so they only work during daylight. Modern mechanical and digital clocks have replaced sundials, but they still hold historical and educational significance. The dial of a sundial often has hour markings to display time accurately.

question:
JJ Thomson is known for developing which model in 1898?

[SSC MTS 2024]
options: Gold foil model
Plum pudding model
Double-slit model
Oil drop model
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Plum pudding model

Explanation:
J.J. Thomson developed the 'Plum Pudding Model' in 1898. This is a model of atomic structure where the atom is depicted as a positively charged sphere with negatively charged electrons embedded in it, like 'plums' in a pudding. The model attempted to explain the electrical neutrality of the atom. Thomson discovered the electron and used this model to describe atomic structure. However, later, Rutherford's gold foil experiment disproved this model and led to the discovery of the nucleus.

Extra Facts:
☛ J.J. Thomson is also known for the 'discovery of the electron', for which he received the Nobel Prize in 1906.
☛ The Plum Pudding Model is also called the 'Watermelon Model', as the positive charge is like the flesh of the watermelon and the electrons are like the seeds embedded in it.
☛ Rutherford conducted the gold foil experiment in 1911, which led to the discovery of a small, dense, positively charged nucleus at the center of the atom.

Explanation:
The neutron was discovered in 1932 by James Chadwick. A neutron is a subatomic particle with no charge (neutral) and is found in the nucleus of an atom along with protons. Chadwick discovered neutrons by bombarding beryllium with alpha particles. This discovery played a crucial role in understanding atomic structure and advanced nuclear physics. For this discovery, Chadwick was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1935.

Extra Facts:
1. The mass of a neutron is nearly equal to that of a proton but about 1839 times heavier than an electron.
2. Before the discovery of neutrons, scientists believed that the nucleus contained only protons and electrons.
3. Neutrons play a key role in controlling nuclear fission reactions in atomic reactors.
4. Neutron stars are formed due to the extreme density of neutrons in collapsing stars.

question:
In 1664, who discovered the fifth star in the Trapezium, an asterism (mini- constellation) in the constellation Orion?

[SSC CGL 2022]
options: George Willis Ritchey
Giordano Bruno
Johannes Kepler
Robert Hooke
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Robert Hooke

Explanation:
In 1664, Robert Hooke discovered the fifth star in the Trapezium, an asterism located in the Orion constellation. The Trapezium is primarily composed of four bright stars and is part of the Orion Nebula (M42). Using his telescope, Hooke observed this region and recorded the presence of a fifth star. This discovery was significant in astronomy as it provided insights into star clusters and their structures. Robert Hooke was a renowned scientist who also contributed to the development of microscopes and telescopes.

Extra Facts:
The Trapezium lies at the heart of the Orion Nebula, a massive star-forming region about 1,344 light-years away from Earth. The four main stars (A, B, C, D) are easily visible with small telescopes. Later observations with more powerful telescopes revealed additional stars in the cluster. The Orion Nebula is one of the brightest nebulae in the night sky and a popular target for astronomers.

question:
Which type of electromagnetic radiation was discovered by Johann Wilhelm Ritter in 1801?

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options: X-rays
Infrared rays
Gamma rays
Ultraviolet rays
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ultraviolet rays

Explanation:
Johann Wilhelm Ritter discovered ultraviolet (UV) rays in 1801. He observed that when sunlight fell on silver chloride (AgCl), it turned black. He concluded that this effect was caused by radiation beyond the visible spectrum (beyond violet light), later named ultraviolet rays. UV rays are part of the electromagnetic spectrum with wavelengths (10 nm to 400 nm) shorter than visible light.

Extra Facts:
Ultraviolet rays are classified into three categories: UVA (315-400 nm), UVB (280-315 nm), and UVC (100-280 nm). UVC rays are absorbed by Earth's ozone layer, while UVA and UVB reach the skin. UV rays are used in sterilization, fluorescent lamps, and DNA analysis. Sunlight-derived UV rays play a crucial role in vitamin D synthesis but can also cause skin cancer in excessive amounts.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams

☛ Who discovered X-rays? → Wilhelm Conrad Röntgen
☛ What is the wavelength range of gamma rays? → Less than 0.01 nm
☛ Who discovered infrared rays? → William Herschel
☛ What is the wavelength range of visible light? → 400 nm to 700 nm

solution_hi:

Explanation:
जोहान विल्हेम रिटर ने 1801 में पराबैंगनी (Ultraviolet - UV) किरणों की खोज की। उन्होंने देखा कि जब सूर्य का प्रकाश चांदी के क्लोराइड (AgCl) पर पड़ता है, तो यह काले रंग में बदल जाता है। उन्होंने पाया कि यह प्रभाव दृश्य प्रकाश से परे (बैंगनी रंग के आगे) के विकिरण के कारण होता है, जिसे बाद में पराबैंगनी किरणें कहा गया। यह विद्युत चुंबकीय स्पेक्ट्रम का एक हिस्सा है, जिसकी तरंगदैर्ध्य (10 nm से 400 nm) दृश्य प्रकाश से कम होती है।

Extra Facts:
पराबैंगनी किरणों को तीन श्रेणियों में बांटा गया है: UVA (315-400 nm), UVB (280-315 nm), और UVC (100-280 nm)। UVC किरणें पृथ्वी की ओजोन परत द्वारा अवशोषित कर ली जाती हैं, जबकि UVA और UVB त्वचा तक पहुंचती हैं। UV किरणों का उपयोग जीवाणुरहित करने (Sterilization), फ्लोरोसेंट लैंप, और डीएनए अध्ययन में किया जाता है। सूर्य से आने वाली UV किरणें विटामिन D के संश्लेषण में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाती हैं, लेकिन अधिक मात्रा में त्वचा कैंसर का कारण भी बन सकती हैं।

question:
As per physicists and their major contributions/discoveries, which of the following pairs is INCORRECT ?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: John Bardeen – Theory of superconductivity
Louis Victor de Broglie – Wave nature of matter
Victor Francis Hess – Cosmic radiation

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Paul Dirac – Liquid helium

Explanation:
Paul Dirac was a renowned physicist known for his contributions to quantum mechanics and the Dirac equation, which predicted the spin of the electron. He also introduced the concept of antimatter. However, the study of liquid helium and the theory of superconductivity were developed by John Bardeen, Leon Cooper, and Robert Schrieffer (BCS theory), not Paul Dirac. Thus, this pair is incorrect.

Extra Facts:
John Bardeen won two Nobel Prizes for inventing the transistor and the BCS theory of superconductivity. Louis de Broglie proposed the wave nature of matter, known as the de Broglie wavelength. Victor Hess discovered cosmic radiation, earning him the Nobel Prize in 1936. Paul Dirac made significant contributions to quantum mechanics and won the Nobel Prize in 1933.

Explanation:
पॉल डिराक एक प्रसिद्ध भौतिक विज्ञानी थे, जिन्हें क्वांटम यांत्रिकी और डिराक समीकरण के लिए जाना जाता है, जिसने इलेक्ट्रॉन के स्पिन की भविष्यवाणी की थी। उन्होंने एंटीमैटर (प्रतिपदार्थ) की अवधारणा भी प्रस्तुत की। हालांकि, तरल हीलियम का अध्ययन और इसकी अतिचालकता का सिद्धांत जॉन बार्डीन, लियोन कूपर और रॉबर्ट श्रीफर (BCS सिद्धांत) द्वारा विकसित किया गया था, न कि पॉल डिराक द्वारा। इस प्रकार, यह युग्म गलत है।

जॉन बार्डीन ने ट्रांजिस्टर के आविष्कार और अतिचालकता के BCS सिद्धांत के लिए दो बार नोबेल पुरस्कार जीता। लुई डी ब्रोगली ने पदार्थ की तरंग प्रकृति की अवधारणा प्रस्तुत की, जिसे डी ब्रोगली तरंगदैर्घ्य कहा जाता है। विक्टर हेस ने ब्रह्मांडीय विकिरण की खोज की, जिसके लिए उन्हें 1936 में नोबेल पुरस्कार मिला। पॉल डिराक ने क्वांटम यांत्रिकी में महत्वपूर्ण योगदान दिया और 1933 में नोबेल पुरस्कार जीता।

question:
In 1950, which Russian astronomer revised the 'nebular hypothesis’, proposing that the sun is surrounded by a solar nebula consisting mainly of hydrogen and helium as well as dust?

[SSC CHSL 2023]
options: Viktor Safronov
George Gamow
Naum Idelson
Otto Schmidt
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Otto Schmidt

Explanation:
In 1950, Russian astronomer Otto Schmidt revised the 'nebular hypothesis', proposing that the Sun was surrounded by a solar nebula composed mainly of hydrogen, helium, and dust. This hypothesis explains the formation of the solar system. According to Schmidt, this nebula condensed to form planets and other celestial bodies. His theory is crucial in modern astronomy as it helps understand planetary formation.

Extra Facts:
The nebular hypothesis was first proposed in the 18th century by Immanuel Kant and Pierre-Simon Laplace. Schmidt refined it, making it more scientifically robust. According to this theory, planets form due to gravitational condensation and conservation of angular momentum. Today, it remains the foundation for understanding planet formation and the origin of the solar system.

question:
Which physicist is known for discovering that any periodic wave can be represented as an infinite number of weighted sinusoids, i.e., the sum of sine and cosine waves?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Louis de Broglie
Jean Baptiste Joseph Fourier
Joseph-Louis Lagrange
Ernest Walton
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Jean Baptiste Joseph Fourier

Explanation:
Jean Baptiste Joseph Fourier was a French mathematician and physicist known for developing the Fourier series and Fourier transform. He demonstrated that any periodic wave can be expressed as an infinite sum of sine and cosine waves. This principle, known as Fourier analysis, is widely used in fields such as signal processing, acoustics, and quantum mechanics. Fourier's work laid the foundation for modern techniques in analyzing complex waveforms by breaking them down into simpler components.

Extra Facts:
The Fourier series is also applied in heat transfer and the analysis of various wave phenomena. Fourier introduced this theory in his 1822 book, "The Analytic Theory of Heat". His discovery revolutionized physics and engineering by enabling the decomposition of complex waves into fundamental frequencies. Today, Fourier transforms are essential in technologies like MRI, audio compression (MP3), and telecommunications.

question:
Who is known as the ‘father of nuclear physics’?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: James Watt
Isaac Newton
E Rutherford
JJ Thomson
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is E Rutherford

Explanation:
Ernest Rutherford is known as the 'father of nuclear physics'. He conducted groundbreaking research on atomic structure and discovered the 'atomic nucleus' in 1911. Through his famous 'gold foil experiment', he proved that most of an atom's mass is concentrated in a tiny nucleus. Rutherford also classified alpha, beta and gamma rays and explained the laws of radioactive decay. His contributions laid the foundation of modern nuclear physics.

Extra Facts:
Ernest Rutherford won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1908. He proposed the 'Rutherford Model' which described atoms as having a positively charged nucleus surrounded by orbiting electrons. His student Niels Bohr further developed this model. Rutherford also discovered the proton and paved the way for artificial nuclear transmutation. He was the first to achieve the artificial disintegration of elements.

question:
Which subatomic particle was discovered by J Chadwick?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Neuron
Proton
Neutron
Electron
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Neutron

Explanation:
James Chadwick discovered the neutron in 1932. The neutron is a subatomic particle found in the nucleus of an atom and carries no electric charge (neutral particle). This discovery was crucial in understanding atomic structure, as it revealed that the nucleus contains not only protons but also another particle contributing to mass without charge. The neutron's discovery paved the way for advancements in nuclear fission and atomic energy research.

Extra Facts:
- The mass of a neutron is nearly equal to that of a proton (~1.675 × 10⁻²⁷ kg).
- Free neutrons are unstable and decay into a proton, electron, and antineutrino with a half-life of about 15 minutes.
- Neutrons help explain isotopes, as atoms of the same element can have different numbers of neutrons while retaining the same number of protons.

जेम्स चैडविक ने न्यूट्रॉन की खोज 1932 में की थी। न्यूट्रॉन एक उप-परमाण्विक कण है जो परमाणु के नाभिक में पाया जाता है और इसका कोई आवेश नहीं होता (तटस्थ कण)। न्यूट्रॉन की खोज ने परमाणु संरचना को समझने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई। इससे यह स्पष्ट हुआ कि नाभिक में प्रोटॉन के अलावा एक अन्य कण भी मौजूद है जो द्रव्यमान प्रदान करता है लेकिन आवेशित नहीं होता। न्यूट्रॉन की खोज ने नाभिकीय विखंडन और परमाणु ऊर्जा के क्षेत्र में नई संभावनाएँ खोल दीं।

Extra Facts:
- न्यूट्रॉन का द्रव्यमान प्रोटॉन के लगभग बराबर होता है (~1.675 × 10⁻²⁷ kg)।
- न्यूट्रॉन मुक्त अवस्था में अस्थिर होते हैं और लगभग 15 मिनट के बाद क्षय होकर प्रोटॉन, इलेक्ट्रॉन और एंटीन्यूट्रिनो में बदल जाते हैं।
- न्यूट्रॉन की खोज ने आइसोटोप्स की अवधारणा को स्पष्ट किया, क्योंकि यह बताता है कि एक ही तत्व के परमाणुओं में प्रोटॉन की संख्या समान हो सकती है लेकिन न्यूट्रॉन की संख्या भिन्न हो सकती है।

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Albert Einstein

Explanation:
Albert Einstein is known for his Theory of Relativity. In 1905, he proposed the Special Theory of Relativity, which explained the nature of time and space. In 1915, he introduced the General Theory of Relativity, which describes gravity as the curvature of space-time. These theories revolutionized the field of physics and contributed significantly to modern science. Einstein was awarded the Nobel Prize in 1921 for his explanation of the photoelectric effect.

Extra Facts:
1. Einstein's famous equation E=mc² (Energy = mass × speed of light squared) demonstrates the relationship between mass and energy.
2. He explained Brownian motion, which helped prove the existence of atoms.
3. Einstein also contributed to the development of quantum mechanics, although he disagreed with some of its aspects.
4. He was born on March 14, 1879, in Germany and died on April 18, 1955, in the USA.

question_hi:
उस विश्व प्रसिद्ध वैज्ञानिक का नाम बताइए जिसे उनके सापेक्षता के सिद्धांत के लिए जाना जाता है।

[RRB NTPC CBT]

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है अल्बर्ट आइंस्टीन

Explanation:
अल्बर्ट आइंस्टीन को उनके सापेक्षता के सिद्धांत (Theory of Relativity) के लिए जाना जाता है। उन्होंने 1905 में विशेष सापेक्षता सिद्धांत (Special Theory of Relativity) प्रस्तुत किया, जिसमें उन्होंने समय और स्थान की प्रकृति को समझाया। 1915 में, उन्होंने सामान्य सापेक्षता सिद्धांत (General Theory of Relativity) प्रस्तुत किया, जो गुरुत्वाकर्षण को अंतरिक्ष-समय के वक्रता के रूप में समझाता है। इन सिद्धांतों ने भौतिकी की दुनिया में क्रांति ला दी और आधुनिक विज्ञान के विकास में महत्वपूर्ण योगदान दिया। आइंस्टीन को 1921 में फोटोइलेक्ट्रिक प्रभाव की व्याख्या के लिए नोबेल पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया था।

Extra Facts:
1. आइंस्टीन का प्रसिद्ध समीकरण E=mc² (ऊर्जा = द्रव्यमान × प्रकाश की गति का वर्ग) है, जो द्रव्यमान और ऊर्जा के बीच संबंध को दर्शाता है।
2. उन्होंने ब्राउनियन गति की व्याख्या की, जिसने परमाणुओं के अस्तित्व को सिद्ध करने में मदद की।
3. आइंस्टीन ने क्वांटम यांत्रिकी के विकास में भी योगदान दिया, हालांकि वे इसके कुछ पहलुओं से सहमत नहीं थे।
4. उनका जन्म 14 मार्च, 1879 को जर्मनी में हुआ था और उनकी मृत्यु 18 अप्रैल, 1955 को अमेरिका में हुई।
